req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns HTTP 204 on success and HTTP 404 when the task does not exist. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing task returns 204 and the task is gone; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent task returns 404 with correct detail; (3) boundary BVA — delete task with id=1 (lowest valid id boundary); (4) STC — state transition: task exists → deleted → second delete returns 404; (5) DT — invalid (non-integer) task_id returns 422. Each test uses an in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB via dependency override, ensuring isolation and determinism.

tests.executable:
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_t = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_del_pos.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_t)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_t)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task to delete", "description": "desc", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    r_delete = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_delete.status_code == 204
    assert r_delete.content == b""
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 404

preconditions: Two tasks exist in the database
expected: GET task B returns HTTP 200 with correct id and title
Task B is unaffected by deletion of task A

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_t = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_del_ep2.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_t)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_t)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_task_does_not_affect_other_tasks():
    r_a = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "completed": False})
    assert r_a.status_code == 201
    id_a = r_a.json()["id"]
    r_b = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "completed": True})
    assert r_b.status_code == 201
    id_b = r_b.json()["id"]
    r_del = client.delete(f"/tasks/{id_a}")
    assert r_del.status_code == 204
    assert r_del.content == b""
    r_get_b = client.get(f"/tasks/{id_b}")
    assert r_get_b.status_code == 200
    body_b = r_get_b.json()
    assert body_b["id"] == id_b
    assert body_b["title"] == "Task B"
    assert body_b["completed"] == True
